_generic_config_notes.purpose: One config schema shared by the Argus engine family (argus-rtsp-watcher, argus-audience-measurement-extension). Both engines use the same configuration.cpp parser: missing fields fall back to defaults, and unknown fields (including every _comment/_notes key here) are ignored. So a project simply ignores the fields it does not use.
_generic_config_notes.usage: Copy this as each project's config source (config.json for argus-rtsp-watcher, which the Go watcher expands per-stream; argus-config.json for argus-audience-measurement-extension). Then set the handful of per-deployment VALUES noted below.
_generic_config_notes.per_project_values: input_source, model conf_threshold/npu_core, employee_detection.enabled, and input URLs/paths differ per project or per site. The schema is shared; these values are not.
_generic_config_notes.model_files: All projects ship model/RetinaFace.rknn and model/yolox_s.rknn (exact case). Always use that case in model_path.
_generic_config_notes.zone: argus-rtsp-watcher injects a per-stream 'zone' object at config-generation time; do not set it here.

_comment_input_source: Which input to use: 'rtsp', 'usb', or 'file'. argus-rtsp-watcher is rtsp (one engine per stream); AME commonly uses usb.
_comment_device_id: Device identifier for MQTT messages. Empty = auto-detect from MAC address.
_comment_input_source_priority: 'config' = read input from this file; 'registry' = read from the BrightSign registry. CLI args always win.

primary_model.name: retinaface
primary_model._comment_conf_threshold: Face confidence 0..1. Higher = fewer false positives. argus-rtsp-watcher default 0.25; AME historically 0.3.

secondary_models.name: yolox
secondary_models._comment_conf_threshold: Person confidence 0..1. argus-rtsp-watcher default 0.1 (sensitive); AME historically 0.5.

_comment_npu_core: -1 = auto (runner picks cores). AME pins cores explicitly (primary 0, employee 2) on multi-core parts; single-core parts (RK3568) only have core 0.
_comment_privacy: Optional person/face blurring in output frames. Ignored where frame output is off.
_comment_flip_horizontal: Mirror the frame horizontally (useful for front-facing USB cameras).
_comment_employee_detection: AME-only feature (MobileNetV3 vest/logo classifier). argus-rtsp-watcher ignores it. Set enabled=true and provide the model only where used.
_comment_light: Light/dark scene detection (analytics/v7.1, topic bs/argus/<id>/light). All fields optional; omitted fields take the defaults shown. enabled (true): run detection. interval_seconds (10): periodic publish period on the light topic. on_change (true): also publish immediately on a state transition. dark_luma (40): EMA luma at/below which colour-mode state is DARK. light_luma (70): EMA luma at/above which colour-mode state is LIGHT (dark_luma must be <= light_luma; the gap is the hysteresis dead-band). chroma_threshold (10): EMA chroma below this means monochrome/IR night image, reported DARK even if bright. ema_alpha (0.1): per-frame EMA smoothing factor. min_dwell_seconds (5): minimum time in a state before it may flip. warmup_seconds (3): state is UNKNOWN until this much data is gathered. roi_frac (0.6): central fraction of the frame sampled. sample_stride (8): minimum pixel sampling stride. monochrome_camera (false): set true for always-grayscale feeds to skip the chroma rule (pure luminance, less robust).
_comment_test_modes: Run a single model for debugging. Both false = production (both models).
